[[PW0:001]]
豆包大模型 2.1 Pro 发布 0915 版本更新，API 已在火山方舟全量上线。这次升级集中在四个方向：Agent 任务交付、多模态写代码、多模态理解、以及推理成本。
[[PW0:002]]
Agent 方面的改进
[[PW0:003]]
模型在需要多轮调用工具、联网查资料再出报告的场景里，强化了证据溯源和数据核验能力，幻觉明显减少。官方给的例子是金融投研：模型能自主拆解研究需求、检索数据源再建模分析，产出的底稿接近分析师水平。为了核实某车企财报里的一个说法，模型调度了 500 多个子 Agent、检索超 1000 个网页，还交叉比对了海事航迹、卫星影像等多源信息。这类"不采信单方通稿、多源交叉验证"的能力，对企业做尽调、出研报有直接价值。
[[PW0:004]]
多模态 Coding
[[PW0:005]]
这次最实用的变化可能是看图写代码。模型现在能直接读懂设计稿、图纸甚至操作录屏，把视觉信息转成前端代码。官方演示了一个场景：给模型一段录屏加几张草图，让它给一个没有文档的老 ERP 系统开发移动端页面——模型读懂了 28 万行 Java 代码，直接还原出可运行的移动端页面。
[[PW0:006]]
在代码仓库理解上，模型对开源游戏 Luanti（约 38.7 万行代码）做了自主修复测试，83% 的任务达到了可合并标准。对经常要在大型项目里定位问题、跨文件修 bug 的开发者来说，这个数字值得关注。
[[PW0:007]]
其他升级
[[PW0:008]]
多模态理解方面，视频推理能力增强，能在视频里定位证据、跨帧整合；图像理解在 3D 物体识别（CAD 工件、游戏引擎元素）和密集图文解析（工程图纸、财报表格）上有明显提升。
[[PW0:009]]
成本方面，图像和视频推理的 Token 消耗比上一代减少 30% 以上。
[[PW0:010]]
API 使用上有两个入口：调用 Doubao-Seed-2.1-pro-0915 可以锁定版本；调用 Doubao-Seed-Evolving 则自动跟进最新版本，不用换 Model ID。豆包工作和 TRAE 也已同步接入。
[[PW0:011]]
官方文章：https://t.co/ZGQCFyKde3
[[PW0:END]]

raw_text:
[[PW0:001]]
Doubao Large Model 2.1 Pro releases the 0915 version update, and the API is now fully available on Volcano Ark. This upgrade focuses on four areas: Agent task delivery, multimodal code writing, multimodal understanding, and inference cost.
[[PW0:002]]
Agent improvements
[[PW0:003]]
In scenarios requiring multiple rounds of tool calls, online research, and report generation, the model has strengthened evidence tracing and data verification, with a notable reduction in hallucinations. The official example is financial investment research: the model can autonomously break down research needs, retrieve data sources, and then build models for analysis, producing draft reports close to analyst level. To verify a claim in a car company's financial report, the model dispatched over 500 sub-Agents, retrieved more than 1,000 web pages, and cross-referenced multi-source information such as maritime trajectories and satellite imagery. This capability of "not trusting one-sided press releases and cross-validating multiple sources" has direct value for companies conducting due diligence and producing research reports.
[[PW0:004]]
Multimodal coding
[[PW0:005]]
The most practical change this time may be writing code from images. The model can now directly read design drafts, blueprints, and even operation screen recordings, converting visual information into front-end code. The official demo showed a scenario: giving the model a screen recording plus several sketches to develop a mobile page for a legacy ERP system without documentation—the model read 280,000 lines of Java code and directly reconstructed a runnable mobile page.
[[PW0:006]]
In code repository understanding, the model conducted autonomous repair tests on the open-source game Luanti (approximately 387,000 lines of code), and 83% of tasks met the merge-ready standard. For developers who frequently need to locate issues in large projects and fix bugs across files, this number is worth attention.
[[PW0:007]]
Other upgrades
[[PW0:008]]
In multimodal understanding, video reasoning capabilities have been enhanced, enabling evidence localization and cross-frame integration in videos; image understanding has improved significantly in 3D object recognition (CAD parts, game engine elements) and dense image-text parsing (engineering drawings, financial report tables).
[[PW0:009]]
In terms of cost, token consumption for image and video inference has been reduced by more than 30% compared to the previous generation.
[[PW0:010]]
There are two entry points for API usage: calling Doubao-Seed-2.1-pro-0915 locks the version; calling Doubao-Seed-Evolving automatically follows the latest version without changing the Model ID. Doubao Work and TRAE have also been integrated simultaneously.
[[PW0:011]]
Official article: https://t.co/ZGQCFyKde3
[[PW0:END]]
